_doc: [v6life] How the world comes back to life where Lumi cleans (core/life_cfg.gd). _default holds every value; a planet block (verdance, ochre, ...) repeats only the keys it changes. Nothing here is saved: a change shows on the next start. See docs/ADJUSTING.md, "The world coming back to life". The sound bed that follows the ground is in data/sound.json, planets.<id>.ambience.life.

ground._doc: green_per_level: how green a clean cell grows, per hex level 0..5 (0 = none, 1 = closed lush sward; 6 numbers). grow_s: seconds a freshly cleaned cell takes from bare to fully green. tufts_per_cell / tuft_rings: grass tufts per cell and rings of cells round Lumi that carry them, per quality preset Low..Ultra (4 numbers each). flower_share: share of tufts that are flowers. petals: flower colours.

town._doc: Each city block rates the cells in and round it. swept_at: clean share for stage 1 (first windows glow at dusk). awake_at: clean share for stage 2 (street lamps on). planted_cells: planted cells (hex level 2+) that, with the block awake, make stage 3 (neon, string lights, shop windows). lit_windows: share of windows lit at dusk per stage 0..3 (4 numbers). lamps_at_stage / signs_at_stage: the stage that turns street lamps / signs and string lights on. ease_s: seconds a block's colour and windows take to follow a change.

flutter._doc: Butterflies by day, fireflies from dusk, over clean cells round Lumi. per_level: how many per cell at hex level 0..5 (6 numbers; about a third of the cells get none). max: most at once. rings: rings of cells round Lumi. colors: butterfly wing colours.

testworld._doc: [v7planet] Dev stub planet (docs/NEW_PLANET.md): only what differs from _default.
